title: Every weekly CFTC report for Three-month SOFR futures: short and spread positions by kind of trader, and open interest
source: CFTC Commitments of Traders, Traders in Financial Futures, futures only (dataset gpe5-46if)
note: Open interest is the total: each kind of trader's short positions plus every spread position add up to it. These are futures positions, not holdings of what the contract is written on.
